own_solution.law: de Broglie relation with non-relativistic momentum: lambda = h/p = hc / sqrt(2 mc^2 K)

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: TBF36 states 200 eV while the other three sentences about the same quantity (an extra kinetic energy) state 100 eV, so it is not a variant differing only in wording and attachment.

notes: Base: sqrt(2 x 511000 x 150) = sqrt(1.533e8) = 12381.4 eV; lambda = 1240/12381.4 = 0.10015 nm. With K = 250 eV: sqrt(2.555e8) = 15984.4 eV; lambda = 0.077576 nm. Physics of every sentence is fine; the only issue is the 200 eV number in TBF36.
